phase: P6 organization roster and factory freeze
workflow: Start an isolated Paper or Folia server with a fresh data directory.
Create an organization as a player and reject a membership change from a non-owner.
Add three distinct members and confirm the four-person roster.
Stop and restart the same server directory, then confirm the roster and owner are restored.
Start the virtual factory from the owner roster and reject later roster changes.
scope_limit: This automated offline-client test covers one normal shutdown and restart on each server. It does not assess human usability, repeated long-duration storage or abrupt-crash durability.
